list.name: domain
list.label: Domain
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT domain FROM pipeline ORDER BY domain

list.name: engine
list.label: Engine
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT lower(jsonb_array_elements(components_json)->>'type') AS engine FROM pipeline ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Total Pipelines
panels.description: Distinct pipelines matching the filters above with at least one run started within the selected dashboard time range (top-right picker). A pipeline with no runs in the window is not counted here even if registered - for the full registry regardless of activity, query the `pipeline` table directly.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(DISTINCT p.pipeline_id) FROM pipeline p JOIN LATERAL (SELECT DISTINCT lower(c->>'type') AS engine FROM jsonb_array_elements(p.components_json) c) comp ON true JOIN pipeline_run pr ON pr.pipeline_id = p.pipeline_id WHERE p.enabled AND p.domain IN ($domain) AND comp.engine IN ($engine) AND pr.status IN ($status) AND pr.started_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()

panels.title: Running
panels.description: Distinct pipelines whose latest run is currently in progress - current state, not bound to the time range picker (a long-running streaming job's started_at can be far outside the selected window).

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(DISTINCT p.pipeline_id) FROM pipeline p LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT DISTINCT lower(c->>'type') AS engine FROM jsonb_array_elements(p.components_json) c) comp ON true LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT status FROM pipeline_run WHERE pipeline_id = p.pipeline_id ORDER BY started_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1) pr ON true WHERE p.enabled AND p.domain IN ($domain) AND comp.engine IN ($engine) AND COALESCE(pr.status, 'unknown') IN ($status) AND pr.status = 'running'

panels.title: Failed (latest run)
panels.description: Distinct pipelines whose latest run status is 'failed' - current state, not bound to the time range picker.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(DISTINCT p.pipeline_id) FROM pipeline p LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT DISTINCT lower(c->>'type') AS engine FROM jsonb_array_elements(p.components_json) c) comp ON true LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT status FROM pipeline_run WHERE pipeline_id = p.pipeline_id ORDER BY started_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1) pr ON true WHERE p.enabled AND p.domain IN ($domain) AND comp.engine IN ($engine) AND COALESCE(pr.status, 'unknown') IN ($status) AND pr.status = 'failed'

panels.title: SLA Breached (now)
panels.description: Distinct pipelines currently in a breached state right now (pipeline_current_sla_status) - a live snapshot, not a 24h event count. For "who missed SLA at some point today", see the Control Tower's "SLA Misses (24h)" tile.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(DISTINCT p.pipeline_id) FROM pipeline p LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT DISTINCT lower(c->>'type') AS engine FROM jsonb_array_elements(p.components_json) c) comp ON true LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT status FROM pipeline_run WHERE pipeline_id = p.pipeline_id ORDER BY started_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1) pr ON true JOIN pipeline_current_sla_status sla ON sla.pipeline_id = p.pipeline_id WHERE p.enabled AND p.domain IN ($domain) AND comp.engine IN ($engine) AND COALESCE(pr.status, 'unknown') IN ($status) AND sla.overall_result = 'breached'

panels.title: Success rate (selected time range)
panels.description: Now bound to the dashboard's time-range picker (top-right) via $__timeFrom()/$__timeTo() - it previously ignored the picker entirely and always hardcoded a fixed 24h window, which is why changing the time range appeared to do nothing. The other stat tiles in this row (Pipelines/Running/Failed/SLA Breached) are deliberately NOT time-bound - they show current live state, not a historical window, so the picker correctly has no effect on those.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE WHEN count(*) FILTER (WHERE pr.status IN ('success','failed')) = 0 THEN 100.0 ELSE round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE pr.status = 'success') / count(*) FILTER (WHERE pr.status IN ('success','failed')), 1) END FROM pipeline p JOIN LATERAL (SELECT DISTINCT lower(c->>'type') AS engine FROM jsonb_array_elements(p.components_json) c) comp ON true JOIN pipeline_run pr ON pr.pipeline_id = p.pipeline_id WHERE p.enabled AND p.domain IN ($domain) AND comp.engine IN ($engine) AND pr.started_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()

panels.title: Pipelines
panels.description: Pipelines with a successful run in the selected time range, PLUS any pipeline currently running or currently failed regardless of when that run started (matching the Running/Failed stat tiles above, which are also not time-bound) - a pipeline whose only activity is an old success outside the window is not shown. Click a row to open Pipeline Detail. Also filtered by the Domain/Engine/Status variables above.

targets.rawSql: SELECT p.pipeline_id AS "Pipeline", comp.engine AS "Engine", CASE WHEN pr.status = 'running' THEN 'Running' ELSE to_char(pr.started_at, 'HH24:MI') END AS "Last Run", CASE WHEN pr.status = 'running' THEN CASE WHEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - pr.started_at) >= 86400 THEN floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - pr.started_at) / 86400)::int || 'd' WHEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - pr.started_at) >= 3600 THEN floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - pr.started_at) / 3600)::int || 'h' ELSE floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - pr.started_at) / 60)::int || 'm' END WHEN pr.duration_s IS NULL THEN 'n/a' WHEN pr.duration_s >= 86400 THEN floor(pr.duration_s / 86400)::int || 'd' WHEN pr.duration_s >= 3600 THEN floor(pr.duration_s / 3600)::int || 'h' ELSE floor(pr.duration_s / 60)::int || 'm' END AS "Duration", CASE WHEN p.sla_json ? 'max_duration_minutes' THEN (p.sla_json->>'max_duration_minutes') || 'm max' WHEN p.sla_json ? 'freshness_target_minutes' THEN 'REALTIME' ELSE 'n/a' END AS "SLA", CASE WHEN pr.status = 'failed' THEN 'failed' WHEN sla.overall_result = 'breached' THEN 'breached' WHEN pr.status = 'running' THEN 'running' WHEN pr.status = 'success' THEN 'success' ELSE 'unknown' END AS "Status" FROM pipeline p JOIN LATERAL (SELECT DISTINCT initcap(c->>'type') AS engine FROM jsonb_array_elements(p.components_json) c) comp ON true JOIN LATERAL (SELECT * FROM pipeline_run WHERE pipeline_id = p.pipeline_id ORDER BY started_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1) pr ON true LEFT JOIN pipeline_current_sla_status sla ON sla.pipeline_id = p.pipeline_id WHERE p.enabled AND p.domain IN ($domain) AND lower(comp.engine) IN ($engine) AND pr.status IN ($status) AND pr.status IN ('running','success','failed') AND (pr.started_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() OR pr.status IN ('running','failed')) ORDER BY p.domain, p.pipeline_id
